taskDescription: Drag each drug name into its correct blank to match the anticancer agent with its biochemical target.
textField: *5-Fluorouracil* is converted to FdUMP, which inhibits thymidylate synthase and causes thymineless death. *Methotrexate* inhibits dihydrofolate reductase, blocking regeneration of tetrahydrofolate. *Imatinib* occupies the ATP-binding site of BCR-ABL tyrosine kinase in chronic myeloid leukaemia.

overallFeedback.feedback: Each drug exploits a specific enzymatic vulnerability: 5-FU traps thymidylate synthase (preventing dTMP synthesis), methotrexate blocks DHFR (starving both thymidylate and purine pathways), and imatinib is a targeted kinase inhibitor for the BCR-ABL fusion protein. Hydroxyurea inhibits ribonucleotide reductase and tamoxifen is an oestrogen receptor modulator — neither matches these three targets.
